title: Demonstratives Consolidation
goal: Review and consolidate all demonstrative adjectives, pronouns, distance relations, and neuter forms.

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can use este, ese, and aquel with masculine, feminine, singular, and plural nouns.
I can use neuter pronouns: esto, eso, aquello.
I can use demonstratives accurately in shopping and spatial navigation contexts.
